class.name: FellowTraversal3D
class.brief_description: FellowEngine: mantling, vaulting, hanging from ledges and climbing ladders for a character's body — a ledge found with physics queries, the body moved onto it (or over a thin obstacle) along a path that keeps its capsule clear, or hung from it and moved along it.

method.name: aim_jump_at_hold
method.description: Aims a jump at a wall at the hold above it (milestone 201): finds a ledge it would hang from in [param direction] (the intent's or the velocity's when zero; a wall up to 1 m further than [member reach_distance], the body running at it as it rises) and returns the takeoff speed up (m/s) that brings the body under [param gravity] to its top 0.08 m over its hang from that hold — the hands on it, the arms a little bent; 0.0 where there is none, or where it needs more than [param max_speed] (0: any). The controller sets its velocity's [code]y[/code] to it. While the body rises the pose's hands reach for the hold (their IK in over the first 30 % of the rise, homing in on it over the rest: [member FellowTraversalPose3D.hand_flight_weight]), the eyes on it; at the top it is caught with the hands on it ([signal hang_started]) and the body settles into its hang. Landing, carried away from the hold or a quarter of a second past the top without it, the aim is given up ([method is_aiming]). Nothing else is looked for while it flies.

method.name: cancel
method.description: Ends the mantle in progress where the body is (its velocity zero); [signal mantle_cancelled] is emitted.

method.name: clear_leap_timing
method.description: Milestone 198: the traversal's own timing for leaps of [param kind] again (a wind-up of [member hang_leap_windup], the body on its curve).

method.name: climb_up
method.description: Hanging: climbs onto the top now if there is room (the same as pushing at the wall).

method.name: find_ledge
method.description: Looks for a ledge in [param direction] (by default the intent, else the body's velocity, else its -Z) without starting anything. The result: [code]kind[/code] (a [enum Kind]), [code]reason[/code] (why it is [constant KIND_BLOCKED], [constant KIND_TOO_HIGH] or [constant KIND_NONE]), [code]edge[/code] (the top's edge on the wall's face), [code]inward[/code] (horizontal, into the wall), [code]top_normal[/code], [code]height[/code] (the top over the feet), [code]target[/code] (where the feet go: on the top, or the vault's landing), [code]depth[/code] (a vaulted obstacle's), [code]open_below[/code] (the body could walk on under it), [code]spread[/code] (milestone 152: hanging from it, each hand this far from [code]edge[/code] along it; 0.24 m, closer on a narrow hold, see [member hold_min_width]) and [code]collider[/code].

method.name: get_action
method.description: The mantle in progress ([constant KIND_LOW], [constant KIND_HIGH] or [constant KIND_VAULT]), or [constant KIND_NONE].

method.name: get_aim_state
method.description: The jump aimed with [method aim_jump_at_hold] under way (milestone 203, decision 0345): [code]time[/code] since the takeoff, [code]catch_time[/code] and [code]rise_time[/code] (s: when the hold will be caught, the top), [code]hang_feet[/code] (where the body's feet will hang from the hold) and the hold's [code]inward[/code]. Empty when not aiming. A controller steers the body in the air with it — the showcase's player brings it to rest where it will hang by the catch, its legs taking the run's speed against the wall.

method.name: get_climb_input
method.description: See [method set_climb_input].

method.name: get_global_stats
method.description: Every traversal's work since the last [method reset_global_stats]: [code]checks[/code] and [code]check_usec[/code] (the ledges looked for), [code]steps[/code] and [code]step_usec[/code] (the physics frames of mantles moving bodies), [code]mantles_low[/code], [code]mantles_high[/code], [code]vaults[/code], [code]hangs[/code], [code]transfers[/code], [code skip-lint]ladders[/code], [code]climbs[/code] (milestone 148: faces climbed), [code]poses[/code] and [code]pose_usec[/code] (the [FellowTraversalPose3D]s' poses). The debugger's Monitors tab shows their time a frame as "FellowEngine/Traversal time".

method.name: get_intent
method.description: The direction set by [method set_intent].

method.name: get_ladder
method.description: The [FellowLadder3D] the body is on, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_last_check
method.description: The last check's result (automatic, [method find_ledge] or [method try_mantle]), as [method find_ledge] returns it.

method.name: get_leap_phases
method.description: Milestone 200 (decision 0342): during a leap up in flight under [member leap_gravity], where its clip's parts are played: the clip's let-go of its last hand and the move's end of the push (shares of the clip's time and of the move's), then the clip's catch and the move's dead point. Empty for any other move. A player that plays the leap's clip over the move plays its first part over the dip and the push, its second over the flight and its last over the settle.

method.name: get_pose_targets
method.description: What the body's pose follows this physics frame (global space), for a pose of one's own: [code]active[/code], [code]kind[/code], [code]progress[/code], [code]inward[/code], [code]hand_left[/code], [code]hand_right[/code], [code]hand_weights[/code] (a [Vector2]: left, right), [code]foot_left[/code], [code]foot_right[/code], [code]foot_weights[/code], [code]foot_follow[/code] (how far each foot's target moves down with the hips), [code]lean[/code] (radians, towards the wall), [code]hips_drop[/code] (meters the hips may hang below the capsule's place), [code]body_offset[/code] (the body shown off the capsule's place: a leap's wind-up, milestone 153), [code]hand_grips[/code] (a [Vector2]: 1 where a hand is on its hold, 0 where it moves to the next; milestone 153), [code]hand_reach[/code] (a [Vector2]: how far along its way to the next hold a moving hand is, 1 on a hold), [code]hold_left[/code] and [code]hold_right[/code] (the hold each hand is on, or from half way between holds going to, where [code]hand_left[/code] and [code]hand_right[/code] will be), [code]hold_normal_left[/code] and [code]hold_normal_right[/code] (the top's normal there), [code]hold_lip_left[/code] and [code]hold_lip_right[/code] (a [Vector2]: how far the stone just under the edge stands out of it and how far under the top its own top is; milestone 198), [code]look[/code] and [code]look_weight[/code] (where the climber looks: the next hold through a move from hold to hold, the way it wishes to shimmy or climb while hanging, over the top through a mantle; 0 on a ladder or a free climb; milestone 154), [code]clip[/code] and [code]clip_time[/code].

method.name: get_progress
method.description: The mantle's progress, 0 to 1 (0 when none is in progress).

method.name: hang_jump
method.description: Hanging, jumps to another ledge the way [method set_intent]'s wish goes, at the next physics frame: along the edge past its end (left or right; the first edge within [member hang_jump_distance] at about the same height, hung from 0.3 m into it; across a gap within [member hang_reach_side], hand over hand instead), up (within [member hang_jump_height], both hands on it; within [member hang_reach_up], hand over hand instead) or down (milestone 86: within [member hang_jump_depth], both hands on it; the body going out to the lower ledge's face first), back (milestone 95: the wish away from the wall: a ledge on the wall behind, within [member hang_jump_distance] of the body's back, at about this edge's height, facing this wall; the body turning round), or diagonally (milestone 93: the wish both along and up or down, each over 0.35: the nearest edge past this one's end within [member hang_jump_distance], 0.4 m higher or lower at least, within [member hang_jump_height] or [member hang_jump_depth]), or round the corner (milestone 149: the wish along with no edge on along it: a ledge on the side of the wall where it turns away, or standing out of it, 0.3 m to [member hang_jump_distance] back from the corner, at about this edge's height, both hands on it; the body out round the corner, turning a quarter, the wish held going on along the new edge), with room for the body there and on the way. Nothing happens when there is none (a wish down then lets go). The body flies there along a curve (0.5 s along, 0.45 s up, 0.4 s down, 0.55 s diagonally, 0.6 s back or round a corner), its hands letting go and catching the new edge; [signal hang_transferred] is emitted when it hangs again. Climbing a face (milestone 148), it lunges over the face the way the wish goes (up without one) by up to [member climb_jump_distance], as far as the face and room for the body go (0.4 m at least), and emits [signal climb_jumped].

method.name: has_leap_timing
method.description: Milestone 198: whether leaps of [param kind] are timed by [method set_leap_timing].

method.name: is_active
method.description: [code]true[/code] while a mantle moves the body.

method.name: is_aiming
method.description: Whether a jump aimed by [method aim_jump_at_hold] is flying to its hold (not caught yet, not given up).

method.name: is_climbing
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the body climbs a wall's face ([member free_climb]).

method.name: is_hanging
method.description: Whether the body hangs from a ledge.

method.name: is_on_ladder
method.description: Whether the body is on a ladder.

method.name: is_transferring
method.description: Whether the hanging body is on its way to another ledge: round a corner ([member wrap_corners]) or in a jump ([method hang_jump]).

method.name: release
method.description: Hanging or on a ladder: lets go (the body falls, pushed a little away).

method.name: reset_global_stats
method.description: Sets the counters of [method get_global_stats] to zero.

method.name: set_climb_input
method.description: On a ladder: up (1) or down (-1), from the controller's own input; 0: from the intent ([method set_intent]: up, or towards the ladder, climbs).

method.name: set_intent
method.description: The way the player wants to go (the input, in global space), set by the controller every physics frame: the automatic mantle checks that way, and a body pressed against a wall (its velocity into it lost to the slide) still mantles. A zero vector: the body's velocity is used.

method.name: set_leap_timing
method.description: Milestone 198 (decision 0340): times a leap from hold to hold as a clip's — [param kind] [constant LEAP_UP] (a leap up) or [constant LEAP_ALONG] (along or across). [param time]: the clip's length in seconds; [param reach]: its own way in meters (up: its rise; along: across) — a longer leap plays slower by the square root of the ways' ratio (as a flight under gravity takes longer), within 0.8-1.6 times. [param progress]: the hips' way along the move sampled evenly over the time (0 at the start, 1 at the end); [param lift]: their height over the straight line (along) or over the end's height (up), in meters, sampled the same way (up, the clip's rise is scaled onto the leap's more in the middle of the way than at its ends: the push's dip and the rise past the end stay the clip's). [param hands]: the leading hand's let-go and catch, then the other's, as shares of the time. The traversal's own wind-up is not played (the clip's push is the wind-up); each hand lets go and catches when the clip's did, on an arc out from the wall; the feet leave the wall as the first hand lets go and brace again as the last catches. The showcase passes [code]tools/blender/mixamo_retarget.py[/code]'s timings from Mixamo's hops.

method.name: try_climb
method.description: Climbs the climbable face in front of the body's chest within [member reach_distance], towards [param direction] (else the intent, else the body's facing), whatever [member free_climb] says. Returns [code]false[/code] when there is none or the traversal is busy.

method.name: try_drop
method.description: Hangs from the edge of the floor the body stands on in [param direction] (the intent's, or the way the body faces, when zero) — its "drop" button: when the floor ends within a step ahead, both hands fit on its edge and the body has room hanging below it. The body goes out over the edge and down in 0.8 s, turning to face the wall ([constant TRANSFER_DROP]); [signal hang_started] is emitted at once, [signal hang_transferred] when it hangs. Returns whether it drops.

method.name: try_hang
method.description: Hangs from the ledge in [param direction] (the intent's or the velocity's when zero) if one is in reach whose top it could climb or is blocked from climbing: a jump's grab done by the controller. Returns whether it hangs.

method.name: try_ladder
method.description: Takes a [FellowLadder3D] in reach (in front of it, the body going towards it; or at its top, going over it). Returns whether it did.

method.name: try_mantle
method.description: Checks for a ledge as [method find_ledge] does and starts the mantle or vault it allows (also one the body could walk under); [code]false[/code] when there is none, a mantle is in progress, the traversal is disabled, or the body is in the air without [member grab_in_air]. For a mantle on a button with [member auto_mantle] off.

members.member: The body turns to face the wall (its -Z into it) over the first 30 % of the mantle.
Checks every physics frame while the body moves (or has an intent) and starts what it finds. Off: only [method try_mantle] starts one.
The horizontal speed under which the automatic check does not run (without an intent).
The body moved; by default the parent.
The physics frames from one automatic check to the next while nothing was in reach (staggered between traversals); with a wall in reach, every frame.
Climbing a face, how far [method hang_jump] lunges over it at most (m).
The physics layers whose faces [member free_climb] climbs (their [code]collision_layer[/code]); the queries still use [member collision_mask].
The most a face may lean over the body (degrees past vertical) to be climbed; a face less steep than [member max_ledge_slope] is walked on instead.

Milestone 203 (decision 0345): from hold to hold, the body pulled up no faster than this (m/s; a person pulls the body up at about 1 m/s): a reach up or across takes as long as that needs, the body rising over its first three quarters, the leading hand reaching the hold as the body gets there (a hand that took the hold first had yanked the body up to it). Milestone 204 (decision 0346): a foot stepping up or across the wall stays within 0.25 m over its hanging place under the body (ahead of it, the leg had folded against the wall). [code]0[/code]: the reaches' fixed times, the hand first.
How fast the body climbs over a face (m/s).

The bone whose position track in the clips is the root's motion: sampled, its rise scaled to the ledge's height and its advance to the distance onto the top (or the landing), it becomes the body's path (kept out of the wall until the feet are within a fifth of the rise of the top — at most 0.3 m —, eased into that hold and out of it); [FellowTraversalPose3D] takes the displacement out of the bone's pose. Empty: the procedural path, the clip only posing the body.
The physics layers the queries see (walls, tops, the room for the capsule).
Draws the last ledge found (its edge and where the capsule goes; green when it can be climbed, red when not) and the mantle's path.
With [member drop_to_hang], the fastest the body may walk over an edge and hang from it, in m/s; faster, it goes over (and falls).

Walking over the edge of the floor (the intent towards it, a [CharacterBody3D] on the floor, no faster than [member drop_max_speed]; the floor ending within a step ahead, more than a metre down), the body hangs from the edge instead, as [method try_drop] (milestone 84). The intent that walked it over the edge points away from the wall: held as it was it does nothing (it would let go); changed, it moves the body as when hanging.
Off: no check, no mantle (one in progress is cancelled).
A [CharacterBody3D]'s speed into the ledge when a mantle ends (a vault keeps its entry speed if that is higher).
If [code]true[/code], the body climbs any face on a layer of [member climb_mask] it pushes at with nothing to mantle onto, or is caught against in the air (milestone 148). See the class description.

In the air (not on the floor, not rising faster than 1 m/s), ledges are grabbed up to 0.5 m higher than [member max_height] over the feet (hanging, the feet are lower). Vaults are not started in the air.

In the air, hangs from a ledge it cannot climb (no room on its top: a ceiling, an overhang) when the edge is about [member hang_reach] over its feet; and with [member hang_first], from every ledge it could climb.

Hanging, the feet braced on the wall this high over the hanging body's feet, in metres: on the wall's face found in front of the body at that height (under a ledge that stands out, further in than its edge; milestone 195: as far out as stone standing out within 26 cm above the foot — a band the shin would go through —, and so through the moves between holds too), or at the edge's face where there is none within reach (an opening). Reaching up ([member hang_reach_up]), the feet step up the wall at this height in turn. [code]0[/code]: off, the feet 0.35 m up at the edge's face (milestone 151, decision 0282).

The clip of a mantle that starts from a hang (climbing up onto the ledge the hands hold), in place of [member high_clip] or [member low_clip]: its first pose the hanging one, its root's motion scaled onto the ledge as theirs is. Unset: theirs (milestone 153, decision 0290).
In the air, hangs from ledges it could climb too, and climbs only when asked (pushing at the wall, up, or [method climb_up]).
Hanging, how far under the edge [method hang_jump] looks for a ledge to drop to when the wish goes down, in metres (milestone 86).
Hanging, how far along the edge past its end [method hang_jump] looks for the next ledge, in metres.
Hanging, how far over the edge [method hang_jump] looks for a ledge to jump up to, in metres.

Hanging, a leap to another ledge ([constant TRANSFER_JUMP_UP], [constant TRANSFER_JUMP_ALONG], [constant TRANSFER_JUMP_DOWN], [constant TRANSFER_JUMP_DIAGONAL], [constant TRANSFER_JUMP_BACK], [constant TRANSFER_JUMP_CORNER]) first winds up for this long, in seconds, the move made longer by as much: the body drawn in to the wall and up a little (its pose's offset; the capsule stays), the hands holding and the feet braced. Then it springs: from rest, faster through the push off the wall, and on to the ledge at a speed slowed by gravity going up or sped going down, caught with that speed (a [FellowTraversalPose3D] with [member FellowTraversalPose3D.body_sway] swings the body on); the hands thrown to the ledge ahead of the body, the leading one first (going down, with the body; turning back, once it has turned), held all the way; the feet pushing off the wall and braced again as it is caught. The path is the same. [code]0[/code]: off, the leap as before (milestone 153, decision 0290).
Hanging, the hands' height over the feet (the body hangs this far below the edge, its capsule [member reach_distance]-free of the top).

Hanging, a gap up to this wide to a ledge to the side (within 0.35 m of the edge's height, both hands on it, room for the body there) is crossed hand over hand ([constant TRANSFER_REACH_SIDE], 0.8 s): holding the wish along at the edge's end (where no corner is found), or by [method hang_jump]. The hand on that side leads, out from the wall to the other ledge's near end; the body swings across under the hands; that hand moves on to its place and the other follows to the near end; the feet step across the wall, the leading side's first. With [member hang_reach_up] too, a ledge past the edge's end up to [member hang_reach_up] higher is reached the same way, pushing up and to the side. A wider gap is jumped across, within [member hang_jump_distance]. [code]0[/code]: off (milestone 152, decision 0285).

Hanging, a ledge up to this far over the edge (0.4 m at least, both hands on it, room for the body there) is climbed to hand over hand ([constant TRANSFER_REACH_UP], 0.75 s): pushing up or at the wall where nothing can be mantled, or by [method hang_jump] with the wish up. The hand that followed last time leads, up to the ledge and out from the wall on the way; the body is pulled up as the other follows; the feet step up the wall in turn. A ledge further up, within [member hang_jump_height], is still jumped to. A push held through a reach goes on climbing: over the top when the ledge reached is the last. In this mode, a hold with no room for the body over it — under an eave or a balcony — is caught from the air where its hands have room (nothing 0.2 m over its edge), and an eave's lip within reach is climbed to like any ledge, the body hanging out from the wall under it, and over it onto the roof (milestone 152, decision 0287). With nothing over the hands, a hold up and 0.3-0.9 m to the side is reached across (with [member hang_reach_side]), and an eave's lip 0.3 m or more out from the hold is reached up to; a hold needs 0.12 m free over its edge (decision 0288). Pushing up from a parapet's top (0.6 m thick at most) with a floor 0.3-1.6 m lower behind it, the body climbs over it onto the floor (decision 0289). [code]0[/code]: off, every ledge above is jumped to and only by [method hang_jump] (milestone 151, decision 0282).

Milestone 203 (decision 0345): hanging, a ledge above beyond a leap's reach ([member leap_push_force], [member hang_jump_height]) and up to this far above is climbed to by standing up on the one the hands are on ([constant TRANSFER_STEP_UP]) — where its top is at least 0.12 m deep and a body fits standing on it against the wall: pulled up until the chest is at the edge, pressed up on the hands with a foot on the top, stood up (the other foot following), reached up to the next ledge (on the toes, as far as it needs), hung from it; each phase eased from rest to rest, the press no faster than 0.8 m/s, the stand 0.9 m/s, the pull [member climb_pull_speed]. The hands' and feet's places go to the pose ([member FellowTraversalPose3D.hand_ik]). [code]0[/code]: off.
The clip played for a [constant KIND_HIGH] mantle (its length is the mantle's).
A procedural [constant KIND_HIGH] mantle's time for a 1.8 m ledge (scaled with the square root of the height, 0.85 to 1.15 times).

A hold narrower than both hands' 0.48 m, down to this wide, is held — a brick, a beam's end, a corbel: hung from its middle with each hand 5 cm in from its ends ([code]spread[/code] in the ledge's dictionary), its ends looked for up to 0.3 m either way. It is caught from the air, reached and leapt to like any ledge (the reach up looks 0.16 m either side of the hands' middle too); the body does not shimmy along it. Where a hang starts, the hands must fit on what is held: a ledge narrower than this is not hung from. [code]0[/code]: off, every ledge reached or leapt to needs 0.48 m, and one caught from the air is held with the hands 0.48 m apart whatever its width (milestone 152, decision 0286).
How far in front of a ladder (past the capsule's radius) the body takes it.
Climbing speed on ladders, in m/s, at full input.
Takes the [FellowLadder3D]s the body goes towards (see [FellowLadder3D]).

Milestone 200 (decision 0342): a leap up timed by [method set_leap_timing] flies under this gravity, in m/s²: the body dips 8 cm, pushes from rest to the speed that carries it to the dead point (a constant acceleration over a quarter of the rise, at least the clip's push and at most 0.65 m), flies decelerating by gravity alone, the hands catching the hold at the dead point (the settle's drop — the clip's hips over its end at its catch — above the hang), and settles into the hang over the clip's own settling time; along the wall and out from it (6 cm in mid-flight) from the push's start to the dead point. The move's time follows (a 2.3 m leap: 1.55 s). The clip's let-go and catch are where its push and flight are played ([method get_leap_phases]). [code]0[/code]: the clip's rise scaled onto the leap's, as milestone 198.

Milestone 203 (decision 0345): a person's strength in a leap up in flight ([member leap_gravity]): the support force at the push's peak, in body weights — the force rising and falling as a half sine from rest (the hips' acceleration [code](F - 1) g[/code] at the peak), the speed off it [code]sqrt(4 d (F - 1) g / pi)[/code] over the push's way [code]d[/code] (at most 0.65 m), no dip down (hanging on straight arms the hips cannot sink: the body swings out from the wall). A ledge higher than such a leap carries the body is not leapt to: it is stood up to ([member hang_step_up_height]) or left. Climbers' explosive pull-ups peak at 1.4-1.7 body weights; with the legs on the wall a strong climber reaches about 2.3 (some 1.2 m of rise). Milestone 204 (decision 0346): the push is as long as that force needs for the dead point (up to 0.65 m), and from the push to the dead point the pose keeps the hips where they were off the body (the clip's own crouch and rise taken out: the body's arc is the push's and gravity's alone); an arcade hero's 5.5 leaps some 2.5 m. [code]0[/code]: no limit.
The clip played for a [constant KIND_LOW] mantle (its length is the mantle's).
A procedural [constant KIND_LOW] mantle's time for a 1 m ledge (scaled with the square root of the height, 0.85 to 1.2 times).
Tops up to this height over the feet are [constant KIND_LOW] mantles, higher ones [constant KIND_HIGH].
The highest top climbed from the ground ([member grab_in_air] adds 0.5 m in the air).

A steeper top is [constant KIND_BLOCKED] ([code]"slope"[/code]). A sloping top within it — a roof — is climbed onto where the body has room standing on its slope (milestone 152: the room looked for clear of the slope; before, a top sloping more than about 23 degrees had "no room on top").
The largest angle between the way the body goes and into the wall; a wall turned farther is passed by.
Lower obstacles are the character's own to step over or jump.
How far beyond the capsule a wall is looked for.

Hanging, the speed along the ledge at full intent, in m/s: the body follows the edge as it turns (up to 50 degrees at a step) and steps (0.3 m), and stops where it ends, at a gap, or at something in the way.
Vaults over thin obstacles.
The clip played for a [constant KIND_VAULT] (its length is the vault's).
A procedural vault's time.
An obstacle whose far side drops within this depth (at least 0.25 m below its top) can be vaulted.
The highest obstacle vaulted.
At this speed or more a thin obstacle with room on it is vaulted rather than mantled.

Hanging, goes round corners where the ledge ends while the intent goes on along it (milestone 81): an outside corner (the wall turning away: onto its side, the body swinging wide of the corner in 0.7 s) or an inside one (a wall meeting the ledge: onto its face in 0.5 s), when the new edge is at the same height, both hands fit on it and the body has room there. Afterwards the intent held as it was goes on along the new edge (a stick held left stays "left" round the corner) until it changes. Off: the body stops where the ledge ends.

signal.name: climb_finished
signal.description: Emitted when the body stops climbing a face: [param at_top] when it goes on over the top (a mantle or a hang follows) or onto ground to walk on at its top, [code]false[/code] when it lets go or reaches the floor.

signal.name: climb_jumped
signal.description: Emitted when a climbing body lunges over the face ([method hang_jump]), [param distance] metres.

signal.name: climb_started
signal.description: Emitted when the body starts climbing a face.

signal.name: hang_finished
signal.description: Emitted when the body stops hanging: [param climbed] if it climbs onto the top (a mantle starts), else it let go.

signal.name: hang_started
signal.description: Emitted when the body starts hanging from a ledge ([param ledge]: as [method find_ledge]'s).

signal.name: hang_transfer_started
signal.description: Emitted when the hanging body sets off for another ledge (milestone 151): [param ledge] the one it goes to (as [method find_ledge]'s), [param how] a [enum Transfer] value, [param duration] the seconds it takes, [param lead_hand] the hand that goes first ([code]0[/code]: the left; reaching up, the hands take turns; jumping, the one on the side it goes to). A controller plays its clip for the move from here.

signal.name: hang_transferred
signal.description: Emitted when the hanging body has reached another ledge, round a corner or by a jump ([param ledge]: as [method find_ledge]'s; [param how]: a [enum Transfer] value).

signal.name: ladder_finished
signal.description: Emitted when the body leaves a ladder: [param at_top] if it climbs off at the top (a mantle starts), else at the foot or let go.

signal.name: ladder_started
signal.description: Emitted when the body takes a [param ladder].

signal.name: mantle_cancelled
signal.description: A mantle of [param kind] (a [enum Kind]) ended before its end: [method cancel], [member enabled] turned off, the traversal left the tree.

signal.name: mantle_finished
signal.description: A mantle of [param kind] (a [enum Kind]) ended with the body on the top or the landing.

signal.name: mantle_started
signal.description: A mantle of [param kind] (a [enum Kind]) began; [param ledge] is the check's result, as [method find_ledge] returns it.

constants.constant: Nothing to climb in reach (or no wall facing the way the body goes).
A top lower than [member min_height].
A mantle onto a top up to [member low_max_height].
A mantle onto a top up to [member max_height] (pulled up from a hang).
Over a thin obstacle up to [member vault_max_height].
A wall with no top below [member max_height] (or the ceiling over the body).
A top, but no room for the capsule on it, above the body or over the edge, or a top too steep (the reason says which).
Hanging from a ledge (milestone 75).
On a [FellowLadder3D] (milestone 75).
Climbing a wall's face ([member free_climb]): the action while [method is_climbing].
Round an outside corner: the wall turning away.
Round an inside corner: onto a wall meeting the ledge.
A jump along the edge, across a gap to the next ledge.
A jump up to a ledge over the edge.
A leap up from one hold to the one above it ([method set_leap_timing]).
A leap along the wall to a hold beside, or across diagonally ([method set_leap_timing]).
From the floor over its edge into a hang from it ([method try_drop], [member drop_to_hang]).
A drop to a ledge below, caught there ([method hang_jump] with the wish down).
A jump along the edge and up or down at once, to a ledge past a gap at another height ([method hang_jump] with the wish both along and up or down).
A jump back to a ledge on the wall behind, turning round ([method hang_jump] with the wish away from the wall).
Round the corner past the edge's end, in the air, onto a ledge on the side of the wall where it turns away (milestone 149, [method hang_jump] with the wish along when there is no edge on along it).
Up to a ledge within [member hang_reach_up], hand over hand (milestone 151).
Across a gap within [member hang_reach_side] to a ledge to the side, or up and to the side within [member hang_reach_up], hand over hand (milestone 152).
Up onto the ledge the hands are on and from it to one above, beyond a leap's reach ([member hang_step_up_height]; milestone 203).
The number of kinds.
